question: Today, because of Russia’s invasion of Ukraine and the resurgence of conflict in the Middle East, Europe’s security architecture is shakier than it has been in decades. As a result, the EU and its Member States have been compelled to look again at substantially ramping up their defence budgets and boosting their defence industries. The Commission has already made moves to that end, but in the Strategic Compass also undertook to facilitate private investment in the defence industry by 2023. 1.
Can the Commission outline the initiatives it has taken, or will be taking, to stimulate private investment in the defence industry?
Does the Commission have figures as to the volume of private-sector investment it intends to marshal?
